heading: Multiple iterations based on stakeholder review sessions
eyebrow: ⚙️ Standardizing user flow with new wireframes

blocks.html: After aligning the prioritized ideas, I updated the entire user flow to enhance user engagement, foster character creation, and promote in-app payments. Once I had shared the user flow in the stakeholder review and received the green light, I guided the team in developing wireframes to visualize key scenarios to re-confirm that we were on the same page. I worked closely with the engineers to ensure the designs were feasible from a tech perspective.
